Vmag: apparent visual magnitude of the star (brightness as seen from Earth)
Plx: parallax of the star in milliarcseconds (measure of distance)
B-V: color index of the star (difference between blue and visual magnitudes)
SpType: spectral type of the star (e.g., G1V, F3V, B8/B9V, K5V)
target: star type classification (0 - dwarf star, 1 - giant star)
